method_note: AIM 2026 (Genoa, Jul 7-10, 2026) technical program on the official site (the PaperCept AIM26 program pages return 403/404). Counted 70 topical oral sessions (369 papers per the site's "N papers" counts), grouping repeated titles (e.g. "Control application in Mechatronics" x5). Excluded as non-topical: 9 "Online/Hybrid Session" slots, 3 "TMECH Paper Presentation" and 1 "RA-L & TMRB Paper Presentations" sessions, the late-breaking poster session, plenaries. Each session split equally across at most 2 keywords; weight = sessions mapped / 70. All counted sessions were mapped. Keywords below 0.02 omitted; listed weights sum to 0.993. deployable-structures: none found at session level in AIM 2026: no session title fits, and the 5 origami/foldable/deployable papers are spread one per session (OriDelta origami delta manipulator and Origami-Inspired 3-DoF Spherical Joint each 1 of 4-5 papers in separate 'Modeling and Design of Mechatronic Systems' sessions; foldable robotic-bird wing 1 of 6 in 'Unmanned Aerial Vehicles'; origami gripper and RDL deployable leg in excluded Online/Hybrid slots), so no session is even half on the topic.
